prompt_sequence.text: A woman walks briskly through a lobby while visibly annoyed, turning naturally around furniture.
She slows, stops at a bus shelter, waits impatiently, and looks toward the street.
She resumes a purposeful walk along the curved sidewalk route and approaches the convenience store.
She reaches for the store door with her right hand, opens it, and walks through carefully.
She navigates the store aisle, stops at the counter, and picks up a small object with her right hand.
A person follows a curved approach toward a wall panel and decelerates.
The person turns, plants both feet, reaches with the right hand, and firmly presses the panel.
The person retracts the hand and recovers into a balanced attentive stance.
